full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media portrait shows a woman's pale face emerging from a restless arrangement of black ink, thin drawing lines, and vivid collage fragments on a white ground. The open background extends to every edge, leaving generous unmarked space around the head. Several faint circular arcs pass behind the crown and around the face, providing a loose geometric scaffold rather than a solid setting. The head occupies the center and turns toward the left with the chin raised, its bright cheek and forehead carefully shaded in cool gray. Dark, heavily lined eyes look upward past the frame, and saturated rose-red lips give the mostly monochrome features a small warm center. Near the right temple and ear, layered fragments of blue, amber, orange, and red interrupt the smooth facial surface. Black triangular and brushy shapes fan upward from the crown and outward behind the ear; narrower strokes, curls, and translucent gray scraps tangle around the lower jaw. The neck dissolves into energetic black washes and irregular white breaks instead of ending at a natural shoulder line. At the right edge of the assembled head, a long ochre drip descends vertically, contrasting with the looping, hair-fine arcs. Ink spatters and fractured blocks of gray texture create a dense zone around the ear, while the left side of the face remains comparatively open and legible. The surface alternates between precise graphite-like facial modeling, sharp cut-paper edges, dry black marks, and translucent watercolor-like stains. Illumination is even and high key across the white sheet, while the rendered face gains depth through darker shading under the eyes, nose, and chin. The overall composition holds a calm, luminous expression inside an asymmetrical burst of lines and fragments, balancing disciplined portrait drawing with spontaneous graphic movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒材肖像呈现一张浅色女性面容，她从白底上躁动的黑墨、细绘线与鲜亮拼贴碎片中浮现。敞开的背景延伸至四周边缘，头部周围留下宽裕空白。数道淡薄圆弧经过头顶后方并环绕面孔，构成松散的几何支架，而不是实在场景。头部占据中央并转向左侧，下巴抬起，明亮的脸颊与额头用冷灰色细致塑形。浓重眼线围住的深色眼睛向画外上方望去，饱和玫红嘴唇在大体单色的五官间构成一处温暖中心。右侧太阳穴与耳朵附近，蓝、琥珀、橙与红色的层叠碎片打断平滑脸面。黑色三角形与笔刷状形体从头顶向上散开，并在耳后向外伸展；更窄的笔迹、卷线与半透明灰片缠绕下颌。脖颈溶入富于活力的黑色洗痕与不规则白色断口，没有以自然肩线收束。组接的头部右缘，一道长赭黄色流痕垂直向下，与发丝般纤细的环线形成对比。墨点和碎裂的灰色肌理块在耳周形成密集区域，脸部左侧则相对开阔、容易辨认。表面在精确的铅笔般面部塑形、锐利剪纸边缘、干涩黑迹和半透明水彩般污渍间切换。白纸上整体光线均匀而明亮，绘出的脸则凭眼、鼻与下巴下方较深的阴影获得纵深。整体构图把平静明亮的神情放进不对称爆散的线条与碎片中，让严谨肖像绘制与即兴图形运动取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media image combines precise grayscale modeling with loose black ink, fine graphite-like arcs, torn-looking fragments, and translucent color stains. Smooth tonal areas carry a focal form, while dense clusters of angular marks break its perimeter and dissolve it into the surrounding white. Thin circular construction lines and long vertical drips counter the short, impulsive strokes, creating several distinct speeds of mark making. A mostly black, gray, and white field is punctuated by concentrated cobalt blue, ochre, orange, and crimson, so the color reads as sharp structural accents rather than an even wash. Open negative space gives the crowded areas room to expand without making the whole frame heavy. High key illumination keeps the paper bright; depth comes from drawn shadows, overlaps, and changes in transparency rather than a depicted light source. The overall effect is elegant and restless, joining controlled draftsmanship to fractured, spontaneous collage energy.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒材画面把精确灰阶塑形与松散黑墨、纤细铅笔般圆弧、撕裂感碎片和半透明彩色污渍结合起来。平顺明度区域承载焦点形体，密集角状笔迹则打破其外缘，使之消散到周围白底中。细圆形结构线与长垂直流痕对照短促即兴笔触，产生数种不同速度的落笔节奏。以黑、灰、白为主的画域被集中钴蓝、赭黄、橙色和绯红穿透，因此颜色像锋利的结构重音，而非均匀色洗。开阔留白让拥挤区域能够扩张，却不使整幅沉重。高调光感保持纸面明亮；纵深来自绘制的阴影、相互遮挡与透明度变化，而不是画内实体光源。整体效果优雅而躁动，把受控的素描功底与破碎、即兴的拼贴能量接合起来。
theme_en: An upward-looking woman's face emerging from abstract ink and colored collage
theme_zh: 仰望的女性面容从抽象墨迹与彩色拼贴中浮现
name: Minjae Lee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
